task: ADR-021 (Contextual Authority Ensemble Routing), amended 2026-10-29 to the confirmed FDD-021 K1 to K7

criteria.description: architectural soundness: Re-approval after §4.1 to §4.5 were aligned with the code: the previous route and agreement counts are derived from episodes and the snapshot holds only human-set configuration (the per-request map would rewrite the snapshot on every decision), dispatch builds a TaskPolicy from a copy because authority is read at construction, only critical escalates by tier, thresholds and bucket approvals are applied by task-policy-routing-set citing an adjudicated approval episode, the bucket prior has a stated formula, only ReinforceLearner gains the routed_authority check, and the 20-outcome floor of the agreement gate is stated not to be binding (a Wilson bound of 0.90 needs 35 agreements without a miss).
